added_lines: prayer for peace in our world loving god, we pray for the people of ukraine, those caught up in the middle east conflict, and for all those affected in any way by war in our world that you will be close to them and protect them. we pray for world leaders, for compassion, strength and wisdom to guide their choices. we pray for the world that in this moment of crisis, we may reach out in solidarity to our brothers and sisters in need. may we walk in your ways so that peace and justice become a reality for the people who are suffering and for all the world. amen. this weekend—friday 16th & sunday 18th of october-we will be remembering all those whose names are listed to- gether on the world map at kilkee church front porch to- gether with the many people who have over the years worked on the mission fields. mission sunday 18th october 2026 fr. ignatius mccormack has been appointed pro-tem to assist in the pastoral area of inis cathaigh and also to help in cois fharraige pastoral area as the need arises. he will reside in kilrush. every good wish and blessing to fr. ignatius in the new role. kilkee church repairs last sumer we embarked on a major project at the front of our church — attending to the damaged concrete and steel at the high elevation and pillars for the large stained glass window, painting of the front of the building and installing new lighting in the front car park. we now have to turn our attention to repairing the concrete at the high elevation of the back of the church. this work will commence over the coming weeks. we are grateful for your donations towards this work though your donations to the repair collection. thank you for your assistance in maintaining the fabric of our church building. blessing of cemeteries the annual blessing and prayers at our parish cemeteries will take place on sunday, 25th october ( weather permitting) cill beag – 2.00 lisdeen — 2.30 p.m kilfearagh — 3.00 farrihy — 3.30 p.m. kilkee (kilfearagh)
